text:
sam | sales: Quick sync — Acadia Health POC. Need a compact timeline + owners for the trial ramp. Customer asked for go/no-go by next Fri.

maya (SE): I'll own day-to-day with them. Main asks: SSO + webhook delivery of inference events + sample dataset ingestion (CSV).

devon - eng: Can confirm SSO via SAML is doable. Need test IdP metadata and a staging cert. ETA: config + smoke tests by Wed next week.

rachel - product: Success criteria from our side: 1) 95% of sample prompts return within 400ms median, 2) end-to-end data flow for 10k records, 3) quality threshold: no more than 5% hallucination on the provided eval set. Customer to provide eval set by Tuesday.

leo (platform): For the private trial we'll spin a dedicated pool — planning reserved capacity 1xA100-equivalent. Need final routing policy: prefer low-latency region us-east-1, fallback to eu-west-1. Also: who signs off on logs retention?

maya (SE): @leo retention: Acadia requested 90d logs, but security asked for 365d. I'll confirm which they actually need and post here.

devon - eng: Integration deliverables checklist (quick):
```
- SAML config + test IdP
- API keys + scoped roles for webhooks
- Webhook schema (v1) and retry policy
- Sample dataset ingestion pipeline (CSV -> S3 -> ingestion job)
- Canary traffic rule and metrics dashboard
```
I'll tag owners next to items by EOD.

rachel - product: Risk notes: if their eval set is >100k rows we should limit to sampled run for latency checks. Also propose a gated rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with rollback on latency or error spikes.

devon - eng: Can we get an agreement on the canary thresholds? I propose: error rate < 0.5%, median latency < 450ms, p95 < 900ms. If breached, auto-fail to fallback model.

sam | sales: Good. I'll communicate those thresholds to the customer and ask for the eval set by Tue. Also ask legal to fast-track the NDA addendum for private pool.

leo (platform): FYI deploy-bot will create the dedicated pool and a canary route once we have the IdP metadata and final model version. It'll post back here.

deploy-bot: created ticket INF-3247 for dedicated-pool provisioning. ETA ~ 2 business days after approval. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

maya (SE): Next actions:
- Acadia -> eval set by Tue (sam)
- SAML metadata -> Acadia to share (maya)
- Logs retention decision (maya + legal)
- devon to list owners for checklist items (devon)
- leo to confirm pool sizing and SLA notes (leo)

sam | sales: Sounds good. I'll send an updated timeline to Acadia this afternoon with linked owners. Ping me if anything blocks the Wed smoke tests. :thumbsup:
